Pesaran's CD test of cross-sectional dependence in a panel

Source: R/envc.R
pcdtst.Rd

Whether the residuals (or any variable) of a unit-by-period panel move together across units, the test Andreatta et al. (2023, p. 1376) run on the residuals of their waste-crime models before deciding a spatial model is not needed. For each pair of units the correlation rho_ab of their values over the T_ab periods they share, about the means over those periods; CD = sum sqrt(T_ab) rho_ab / sqrt(m) over the m pairs, which for a balanced panel of N units and T periods is sqrt(2 T / (N (N - 1))) sum rho_ab, standard normal under no dependence. Pairs that share fewer than two periods, or along which a unit does not vary, are left out. This is the statistic of plm::pcdtest(test = "cd"). For dependence between neighbours rather than across all pairs, use gmoran() on each period's residuals, as Andreatta et al. also do.

Usage

pcdtst(x, unit, time)

Arguments

x

The values of each row: finite numbers (residuals of a panel model, typically).

unit

The unit of each row: labels.

time

The period of each row: numbers; each unit at most once per period.

Value

A named numeric vector: cd, p (two-sided normal), rho and absrho (the mean correlation and the mean absolute correlation of the pairs), pairs (m), units and periods.

References

Andreatta, D., Favarin, S., Lisciandra, M. and Millemaci, E. (2023). Digging into waste: an analysis of waste crime in the Italian provinces. Regional Studies, 57(7), 1367-1379. doi:10.1080/00343404.2022.2135697

Examples

set.seed(3)
d <- expand.grid(year = 2009:2017, prov = paste0("p", 1:20))
common <- rnorm(9)
d$e <- rnorm(180) + 0.8 * common[d$year - 2008]
pcdtst(d$e, d$prov, d$year)
#>           cd            p          rho       absrho        pairs        units 
#> 9.390043e+00 5.997592e-21 2.270751e-01 3.385986e-01 1.900000e+02 2.000000e+01 
#>      periods 
#> 9.000000e+00 
# the residuals of a two-way fit
d$x <- rnorm(180)
d$y <- d$x + d$e
pcdtst(fepnl(d$y, d$x, d$prov, d$year)$resid, d$prov, d$year)
#>           cd            p          rho       absrho        pairs        units 
#>  -2.14401630   0.03203158  -0.05184776   0.29758687 190.00000000  20.00000000 
#>      periods 
#>   9.00000000
